simpler_scene.heading: Intuitive Analogy: Connecting Like a Phone Call
bullets: Receiver answers: 'Yes, I hear you! Can you hear me?'
simpler_scene.narration: To make this much simpler, imagine calling a friend over a walkie-talkie. You never blurt out your secret message immediately. First, you check if their radio is on and clear. That simple three-part greeting is exactly what computers do.
simpler_scene.visual_hint: Friendly cartoon comparison of two walkie-talkie users greeting each other beside client and server computers

checkpoint.q: What is the primary purpose of the greeting exchange?
options: To verify both sides are ready to communicate
